title: Overnight Greek Yogurt Cream Cheese
one_liner: Strain Greek yogurt overnight to make a thick, probiotic-rich cream cheese alternative.
key_points: Only 3 ingredients: Greek yogurt, salt, and lemon juice
Strain through kitchen paper on a sieve overnight to thicken
Flavor with chives, spring onions, honey, or olive oil
Replaces store-bought cream cheese with no additives

instructions: Mix salt and lemon juice into the Greek yogurt.
Place kitchen paper over a sieve set above a bowl.
Pour yogurt mixture onto the kitchen paper.
Leave in the fridge overnight to strain.
Remove and shape as desired. Add toppings like honey, olive oil, or herbs to serve.
